description: Use to brief a foreign business on recent official Chinese regulations and policy releases (State Council English releases, MOFCOM). Inputs: optional "limit" (1-20, default 5), "topic" (tag/keyword, e.g. "trade", "export control"), "since" (YYYY-MM-DD). Output: JSON list of items with date, source, title, summary, tags and a link to the original. Cost: 1 prepaid credit per call with "Authorization: Bearer <key>"; without credits it returns a 402 payment_required result with buy links (see get_pricing).

since.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only items on or after it.
